resumo: Open source catalog of reusable skills and workflows for AI agents, installable in Claude Code and Codex.

estudoDeCaso.problema: AI agent skills and workflows are usually tied to a single tool and copied by hand from one tool to another.
decisoes: Platform-agnostic architecture: one canonical implementation per skill and documented packaging per tool.
Repository contracts verified by Python tests and behavior evaluations with recorded scenarios and results.
Implementation, documentation, tests and platform integration kept separate.
estudoDeCaso.resultado: Open source catalog with 15 skills, one of them orchestrating a composed workflow (chain), packaged for Claude Code, Codex, Pi and Hermes Agent, with a suite of 41 Python tests.
estudoDeCaso.aprendizado: Defining stable contracts across different tools and testing agent behavior, not only code.
